settings.title: Compliance settings
settings.noticeDaysNote: Default notice for the deadlines the module records in the shared deadline schedule.
settings.notificationsNote: When off, the module sends no notifications or reminders. Each user chooses how to receive them from the notification preferences.
settings.healthUsersNote: Occupational physician or designated safety manager: they see and write the health data of the examinations (encrypted). The other administrators only see outcome and expiry.

list.confirmDelete: Delete the item? The related deadlines are removed from the deadline list.
list.exportStarted: Export started: the file will be available in the jobs bar
list.chooseCompany: Choose the company to work on.
list.noCompanies: No company of the firm has Compliance active.
list.notAllowed: No section available for the user.

edit.courseExpiryNote: If empty, it is calculated from the course validity required by the job roles (the shortest).
edit.referenceNote: Reference to the document (protocol, position in the archive or document management): the file is not uploaded here.
edit.limitsNote: Summary of the prescriptions or limitations of the fitness judgement, useful to organise the work.
edit.healthDataNote: Health data: visible only to the users enabled in the settings, stored encrypted, never in the AI chat or in exports.
edit.appointeeNote: Appointed employee; for an external person leave empty and enter the name.
edit.validityNote: Months of validity of the course (empty = no expiry).
edit.breachDiscoveryNote: The 72 hours for the notification to the supervisory authority start from this moment.
edit.breachRiskNote: Unlikely risk: no notification due. High risk: also communication to the data subjects.

mine.title: My compliance
mine.notEmployee: The user is not linked to an employee of the company.
mine.note_formazione: Safety training courses attended and their expiry.
mine.note_visite: Medical examinations with the fitness outcome and the date of the next examination.
mine.note_consegne: Protective equipment received: the delivery is confirmed in the acknowledgements page.
mine.note_nomine: Safety appointments: the appointment is confirmed in the acknowledgements page.

sectionNotes.formazione: Courses attended by the employees: the most recent course of a type renews the previous ones; the expiry goes to the deadline list.
sectionNotes.stato: Courses required by the active job roles of each employee and last course attended: missing and expired ones highlighted.
sectionNotes.visite: Medical examinations: fitness outcome and date of the next examination (in the deadline list). Health data only for enabled users.
sectionNotes.consegne: PPE deliveries: the employee with a user confirms the delivery (report) in the acknowledgements.
sectionNotes.nomine: Safety manager, workers' representative, supervisors, emergency and first aid officers, occupational physician: the end of the appointment goes to the deadline list.
sectionNotes.documenti: Risk assessment, emergency plans and procedures with version, review and expiry.
sectionNotes.mansioni: Job roles with their risk level.
sectionNotes.corsiMansione: Mandatory courses for each job role and validity in months.
sectionNotes.assegnazioni: Job roles assigned to the employees, with dates.
sectionNotes.dpi: Personal protective equipment that can be delivered (those already delivered are disabled).
sectionNotes.responsabili: External processors and appointments (art. 28 GDPR): the agreement expiry goes to the deadline list.
sectionNotes.violazioni: Breach register (art. 33 GDPR): the notification to the authority within 72 hours of discovery is in the deadline list until it is recorded.
sectionNotes.scadenze: Compliance deadlines of the company (safety and GDPR), read only.

common.showDisabled: Also show renewed, inactive and closed
